mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri počte hotových dejov („three penalties“) patrí Present Perfect Simple: „has scored“, nie „has been scoring“.

mistakes.feedback_en: When you count finished actions (“three penalties”), use Present Perfect Simple: “has scored”, not “has been scoring”.
